name: io.github.bea-technology/roxyon
description: Build LumenJS apps, use the Roxyon BaaS, and deploy apps and web projects to Roxyon infrastructure.

environment_variables.name: ROXYON_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: A roxp_ personal access token (alternative to `roxyon login`). Create one with `roxyon token create`.

environment_variables.name: ROXYON_API_URL
environment_variables.description: Override the BaaS base URL (default https://www.beaapis.com/1).

environment_variables.name: ROXYON_CONSOLE_URL
environment_variables.description: Override the console base URL (default https://console.roxyon.com).
